tickets.title: Home tells the truth and uses its spare rows
tickets.what:
Home's first screen agrees with the Project tab and does not sit blank. Owner, 2026-11-17, from a
live read of a 38 × 46 panel: Home said "✓ 没有需要你处理的事 · 0 运行中" while Project showed "等你处理 5"; Home's
progress block was titled "里程碑 0.1.4" but counted the whole ledger (60 to try / 38 accepted / 4 dropped, against 0.1.4's
4 to try); about 37 of 46 rows were blank; the summary was cut after one row; the bottom said "✓ 0 今日完成".

acceptance.text: Home's top line counts STATE's "Waiting for the owner" items as well as job questions, e.g. `? 5 项等你处理 · 0 运行中`; ✓ shows only when both are zero. Enter (or a click) on it opens the Project hub's Waiting block.

Home's progress block counts the current milestone's slices exactly as the Project hub does (`currentRows` in `src/render/project-view.ts`); with no current milestone it is titled as the whole ledger, not a milestone.
The progress summary wraps to up to three rows when spare rows allow; it shrinks before the bar does.
A "done today" count of 0 is not shown.

When cards and decisions leave most of Home empty, the spare rows show the waiting items (one row each) and the newest landed slices above the progress block; with live cards these shrink first, cards keep priority as today.
Main-path frame tests (synthetic STATE) for the top line, the milestone counts and an idle Home.

tickets.title: Project hub uses its room and keeps Now about work
tickets.what:
The Project hub shows whole waiting items and a Now block that is about work in flight. Owner,
2026-11-17: the hub had ~19 blank rows while each waiting item was cut to one row, losing the action at its end
("Contr…", "reopen `/hud` i…"); Now held only three `! MyHUD-xxx 未记入清单` rows (worktrees not in the ledger); the
name row read `0.1.4 ▾ 1/4` with an unexplained `1/4`; the progress bar's ▓ (to try) and █ (accepted) were hard to tell
apart.

acceptance.text: A waiting item wraps to two rows when the hub has spare rows; on a short panel it falls back to one cut row before Latest or the page rows give way. The Waiting header says how many of the items are tries.
Worktrees not in the ledger leave Now. The Working tree page row counts them (e.g. `3 个未登记工作树`) and its page lists them. An empty Now shows one muted row saying nothing is in progress.
The name row's `1/4` says what it counts (e.g. `项目 1/4`), or is dropped if it adds nothing.
The to-try and accepted inks on every progress bar differ clearly in every theme, not only by glyph.
Main-path frame tests (synthetic STATE and worktrees) for wrapping, Now without unlisted worktrees, and the Working tree count.

tickets.title: Skills reference moves into Help
tickets.what:
The Skills tab's list becomes a section of Help (`?`), freeing the third main tab. Proposed by the
orchestrator on 2026-11-17 as a matter of taste: the list is a fixed reference opened rarely.

Owner question: `docs/spec.md` (Skills tab, owner, 2026-11-17) makes Skills the third main tab after Project. Moving it
changes the spec and removes a visible tab. Keep the tab, or move it into Help?

acceptance.text: Help shows the same list with the same wrapping; Tab cycles Home ↔ Project.
